summary: Oceanhawk Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO and over-allotment option on May 22, 2026, selling 18.4M units at $10.00/unit for $184M gross. Simultaneously, it sold 530K private placement units to sponsor and underwriter for $5.3M. Net proceeds of $184.92M were placed in a trust account. The non-US Cayman Islands SPAC follows blank-check company rules. The filing documents the IPO closing, with standard SPAC mechanics and trust funding. What to watch is the timeline for a business combination target announcement ahead of the 2-year deadline.
